## DSH behavior checklist

- [ ] Model-visible behavior and execution enforcement remain aligned.
- [ ] Session > project > global precedence is preserved or intentionally updated.
- [ ] User-facing documentation is updated in both English and Chinese when applicable.
- [ ] Prebuilt `lib/` files are refreshed when runtime code changes.
- [ ] No credentials, private URLs, local settings, or personal data are included.
